items.summary: Microsoft Teams will expand Markdown support in the compose box, allowing users to write with visible syntax, use a Markdown toolbar, preview messages, and switch between Markdown and rich text. Public preview starts mid-December 2026; general availability begins mid-January 2027. No admin action needed.

items.title: MC1567262: Microsoft 365 Backup: Up to 10-year recovery windows for SharePoint and OneDrive
items.summary: Microsoft 365 Backup now allows configurable recovery windows up to 10 years for SharePoint and OneDrive, extending from the previous 2 years. Administrators can set recovery periods from 3 months to 10 years, while Exchange backup windows remain unchanged. No action is needed unless longer retention is desired.

items.summary: Update Microsoft Teams mobile to version 1416/1.0.0.2026151302 (Android) or 8.19.0 (iOS) by April 1, 2027, to maintain file access. Older versions will lose file functionality due to a shift to Microsoft Entra ID authentication replacing pre-authenticated URLs. Begin updates now.

Devices on iOS/iPadOS 17 or earlier can keep using current app versions but won't get updates or new features. No admin action needed; users should update their OS to continue receiving updates.

items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a streaming switchboard for event producers to manage and stream up to eight NDI sources in meetings and events, rolling out worldwide from mid-November to mid-December 2026. Admins must enable NDI streaming, and users must activate production capabilities in Teams.

items.summary: The dotted-line manager feature in Microsoft 365 profile cards has been postponed indefinitely, with no new rollout date. Organizations should not expect this feature soon and need to update any related plans or communications accordingly. No preparation is required at this time.

items.summary: Users relying solely on Microsoft-provided SMS/voice for MFA in sessions that don’t support passkeys must register alternative methods or configure customer-managed telephony before SMS/voice retirement begins February 1, 2027 (July 1 for admins/external users). Prepare early to avoid sign-in blocks.
